title: Kodak Disc 3100 Camera Gold and Black Vintage - Untested - Made In USA
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Disc Cameras
descriptionText: The Kodak Disc 3100 Camera is a vintage photography device known for its unique disc-shaped design. Made in the USA, this gold and black camera is a collectible piece for photography enthusiasts. The Kodak 3100 model offers a retro aesthetic and is untested, adding to its charm as a vintage find. With its classic design and American craftsmanship, this camera is sure to appeal to collectors and photography buffs looking to explore the history of disc cameras.
